production_preset_events.rationale: Decision recorded in the committed diagnostics/upstream_253069_migration/HARNESS_UPDATE.md; the sweep it rests on is committed upstream (Olhoff@6b0870850d7407a0f2fc31dbf0d0f318c2e5f2f7 repro/results, SWEEP_R06.md). The Pedersen/adaptive-box formulation is a distinct, scientifically defensible reconstruction whose committed nine-mesh R = 0.06 sweep terminates cleanly without localized-mode spikes; its success is primarily formulation stability, not a better KKT point; the historical eq.(4b) formulation remains reproducible under its own name. The historical preset's cross-mesh termination was not credible (TERMINATION_CROSS_MESH_NOT_CREDIBLE). Not chosen for better-looking topology. Supporting local analyses scientific_delta_olhoff_migration and nine_mesh_campaign_audit are supplementary and uncommitted (source.supplementary_local_evidence_not_required).
production_preset_events.authorization: Migration gate only (160x20). A new nine-mesh campaign requires separate owner authorization.
